title: Analyzing LLM Reasoning to Uncover Mental Health Stigma

bias_targets.methodology: Presenting LLMs with clinical vignettes of fictitious individuals exhibiting symptoms of various psychological conditions, asking multiple-choice questions regarding social distance and perceived danger, and using an LLM-as-a-judge to annotate the models' chain-of-thought reasoning for stigmatizing language based on a clinically-grounded taxonomy.
